blurb_title: Whoever is removed from the group is no admin on the next login. Nobody touches OpenBao.
blurb_1: This guide deploys Keycloak via operator with a CNPG database and a certificate from our own CA, imports a realm as code – client, group mapper, groups, users – and connects OpenBao to it via OIDC. Group membership becomes policies through external groups.
blurb_2: Proven with ID tokens: alice gets identity_policies [admin], bob [kv-reader], bob reads and may not write. Four errors on the way, three of them before the first login: two missing CRDs, a startup probe too tight, our own PKI role, Account is not fully set up.
code: -- Four objects carry the group Keycloak: group openbao-admins → mapper "groups" OpenBao: identity/group openbao-admins (external, policies=admin) identity/group-alias openbao-admins @ accessor of auth/oidc
